title: Conveyancing Legal Secretary
description:
Residential Conveyancing Legal Secretary

Norwich, Norfolk

Full-time Permanent

Monday to Friday 9.00am - 5.00pm

We're working with an established and highly regarded law firm who are looking to recruit an experienced and professional Legal Secretary to join their Residential Conveyancing team in Norwich.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Legal Secretary with a background in Residential Conveyancing who enjoys working closely with fee earners, clients and third parties and wants to become an integral part of a friendly and supportive property team.

The Role

Working closely with the Conveyancing team, you'll provide dedicated secretarial and administrative support, assisting with the preparation and progression of residential property matters and ensuring files are managed accurately and efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Assisting fee earners with case preparation and the progression of matters
- Preparing and drafting legal documents and correspondence
- Managing electronic files and maintaining accurate records
- Audio typing and producing correspondence and documentation
- Assisting with billing and accounts administration
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, solicitors and other third parties
- Handling telephone and email enquiries
- Providing general administrative and secretarial support to the Conveyancing team
- Helping to ensure matters progress efficiently and within required timescales

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced as a Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant within Residential Conveyancing - essential
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Confident managing a varied workload and prioritising effectively
- An excellent typist with strong IT skills
- Confident communicating with clients and third parties
- Professional, friendly and approachable
- Able to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team
- Reliable, proactive and committed to providing a high level of support and client service

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Opportunity to join an established and respected law firm
- Dedicated support role within an established Residential Conveyancing team
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- 35-hour working week
- Monday to Friday, 9.00am - 5.00pm
- Full-time, permanent position
- Comprehensive benefits package including:
- Profit-share bonus
- Bupa cash plan health cover
- Enhanced pension
- Death in service benefit
- Discounted personal legal services
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Regular social events and team activities

Why Apply?

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Residential Conveyancing Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant looking to join an established team in Norwich and play a key role in supporting fee earners and clients across a busy residential property caseload.

Interested? Apply now

title: Conveyancing Secretary
description:
We are looking for an experienced Residential Conveyancing Secretary for our client based in Norwich.

Core Responsibilities
- Client Care: Take instructions, explain legal terms, and provide estimates of fees.
- Property Searches: Conduct local authority, environmental, and water searches to identify issues.
- Title Checking: Examine Land Registry documents and title deeds to confirm ownership and boundaries.
- Drafting Contracts: Prepare sales contracts and negotiate terms with the opposing side's solicitor.
- Financial Handling: Manage deposits, mortgage funds, and calculate Stamp Duty.
- Exchange and Completion: Exchange contracts, transfer funds, and register the new ownership with the Land Registry.

Key Skills and Qualifications
- Qualifications: Often a qualified Solicitor, Licensed Conveyancer, or Legal Executive.
- Attention to Detail: Ability to spot legal risks in complex property titles and searches.
- Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to liaise with clients, estate agents, and mortgage lenders.
- Time Management: Capable of handling a heavy caseload under tight deadlines.
- IT Proficiency: Experience using computerized case management systems and the Land Registry portal.

Please apply with your updated CV.

title: Wills & Probate Paralegal
description:

As a private client paralegal, you will be responsible for:
- Assisting the private client lawyers with probate and estate administration
- Draft correspondence and documents ensuing they are accurate and meet our customer's requirements
- Using case management systems to generate and complete correspondence and documents
- Coordinating and attend meetings, take instructions and notes and liaise with customers
- Researching laws and regulations
- Liaising with other professionals such as financial advisor's and accountants
- Assisting the team with their case-load as appropriate
- Review client documents
- Assist with ensuring client billing is undertaken accurately and within deadlines

This firm is invested in each employee's career progression especially for paralegal's, as their goal is to progress and retain the best legal professionals.
